newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma ranges, bonds rally, short forwards up.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma ranges, bonds rally, short forwards up.

text.p: Greek depos were holding morning levels, short-term forex forwards nudged higher, fixed coupon bonds and zeros gained more ground and ecu/drachma was trading around 310.63/68 in late dealings, traders said.
"Depos are little changed in late trade but short-term forex forwards are firmer with the rest of the curve holding," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "The market is very quiet."

The central bank drained 200 billion drachmas at 11.90 percent in its regular competitive interest rate tender on Wednesday. The allotment ratio was 5.01 percent, slightly higher than last Wednesday's 4.96 percent.

Three-, five-and seven-year fixed coupon bonds and zeros continued their climb with price gains of 30 basis points for two-year zeros, 25 basis points for three-year coupon bonds and 20 basis points for five-year bonds, dealers said.
"Prices of three-, five- and seven-year coupon bonds gained again on renewed buying interest from domestic and foreign players," a bond dealer said.
The 10.20 percent, three-year bond due 2000 gained 25 basis points to 102.55, the 9.20 percent, five-year bond due 2002 rose 20 basis points to 101.45, the dealer said.
"Prices of two-year zeros due January 20, 1999 increased from 85.50 to 85.80," the dealer said.
The mark was quoted at 158.10/20 from Wednesday's 159.005 fix, the dollar at 267.89/99 drachmas from 267.990 and the ecu at 310.66/76 from 310.470 drachmas.

"Ecu/drachma is trading around 310.60/65 in late trade," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank. "Ecu/drachma opened at 310.70/75 then eased to 310.40/50 but rose after the fixing to touch 310.80 before dipping again," the dealer said.
